rules.description: Rule id → severity override, or "off" to drop the rule's findings. Rule ids are listed in docs/RULES.md.

paths.description: Project-relative glob patterns (*, **, ?). Findings whose files all match are dropped.

baseline.description: Report only findings the change introduces: "base" compares with the base ref; a path (inside the project) uses a baseline file written by `preflight baseline`.

gate.description: Quality gate policy, evaluated with --gate and by the GitHub Action.

failOn.description: Fail when any finding is at or above this severity (default: high).

aiAssistedApprovals.description: Changes with AI-assisted commits need at least this many approvals (default: 0, not required).

requireAgentTests.description: Agent actions the change affects must be covered by a Testing Center test.

requireTestsPassed.description: The generated Apex tests must have run in an org (preflight tests --validate) and passed.

requireAgentTestsPassed.description: Testing Center tests for the affected agents must have run (preflight agent-tests) and passed.
